messages:
emily: Quick idea — in saved queries folder view, show a mini "cost vs quota" heatmap for all saved queries so teams can spot hotspots before they run. Would be a bulk-preview rather than per-item hover.

devin: love it. small UI: 3 columns (predicted cost, effective route, quota impact). Each cell a tiny sparkline + color (green/yellow/red). Hover opens full preview.

rachel: backend thoughts: we only compute predictions per-query on-demand currently. Bulk might mean N calls to routing simulator — need batching/caching.

tony: infra: can't hammer the routing service. Suggest we add a bulk-preview endpoint that accepts up to 50 saved_query ids and returns lightweight predictions. We'll implement async cache population + incremental polling.

lucy: telemetry: to attribute heatmap we need sample_id per saved_query version and a small synthetic-sample run that estimates token burn. We can reuse preview_sample_id pattern.

emily: UX note: default heatmap should use "team budget" (if set) to color; otherwise use route default quota. Also add a CTA to "reserve preview quota" for teams so previews are accurate for peak.

devin: API sketch:```POST /api/v2/saved_queries/bulk_preview
{ "ids": ["sq-1","sq-2"], "max_items":50 }
// response: { previews:[{id, predicted_model, cost_per_1k, risk_level}], cache_ttl_seconds:120 }
```

rachel: response must be strings/numbers only. Also include preview_generation_id so console can subscribe to updates rather than polling many times.

tony: implementation plan: (1) enqueue job -> compute lightweight simulation -> write to preview cache; (2) respond quickly with preview_generation_id and any cached values; (3) console subscribes on /previews/:gen_id/ws or polls /previews/:gen_id/status. Rate limit: 2 calls per user/minute.

lucy: add metric preview_job_missed_quota_count and preview_job_error_reason for observability. Also tag by team_id so we can roll up heatmaps for admins.

emily: permissions: make bulk preview visible only to roles with view_saved_queries. For "reserve preview quota" action, require billing admin.

devin: UX edge case: if a query has no route (or route is private), show an info icon and "route unavailable" state; allow users to request a route check.

rachel: API addition: GET /api/v2/previews/:gen_id?expand=items,meta returns items as strings only: id,model_hint,effective_model,score_label. Keep heavy explanations behind telemetry link: /telemetry/preview/:gen_id.

tony: caching policy: stale-after 2m for stable routes, 7m for canary routes. Bulk_preview job should mark entries stale by route version and last_deploy_ts.

lucy: also track preview_divergence_ratio per generation: fraction where effective_model != served_model in first 100 real requests. We can surface a small badge in the heatmap for generations with divergence > 0.2.

emily: next actions: devin protos a compact heatmap with hover states; rachel + tony to spec the bulk_preview endpoints + TTLs; lucy to define telemetry schema; I'll open a tiny RFC and feature-flag it.

preview-bot: Feature flag "bulk-saved-query-heatmap" created, off in prod.

emily: thanks — please add acceptance criteria: bulk_preview must never exceed N routing simulator calls per minute per org, and stale cache must be cleared when route rollout completes.
